project.title: Microbiome of Bulk Soil near Alder Trees in New Hampshire
project.description: A field survey of the microbial community found in the bulk soil near alder trees at five different locations in New Hampshire over several years. Both prokaryotic and fungal communities were profiled during different seasons.
